title: List the names of events where the amount spent on 'Advertisement' is great
question: List the names of events where the amount spent on 'Advertisement' is greater than the average cost of all expenses made by members who have incurred expenses in more than one event.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_members AS (
    SELECT e."XCL_022" AS member_id
    FROM expense AS e
    INNER JOIN budget AS b ON e."XCL_023" = b."XCL_003"
    INNER JOIN event AS ev ON b."XCL_009" = ev."XCL_010"
    GROUP BY e."XCL_022"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ev."XCL_010") > 1
),
avg_expense AS (
    SELECT AVG(e."XCL_020") AS avg_cost
    FROM expense AS e
    WHERE e."XCL_022" IN (SELECT member_id FROM qualifying_members)
),
ad_budget AS (
    SELECT ev."XCL_010" AS event_id, ev."XCL_011" AS event_name, SUM(b."XCL_005") AS ad_amount
    FROM budget AS b
    INNER JOIN event AS ev ON b."XCL_009" = ev."XCL_010"
    WHERE b."XCL_004" = 'Advertisement'
    GROUP BY ev."XCL_010", ev."XCL_011"
)
SELECT ab.event_name
FROM ad_budget AS ab
CROSS JOIN avg_expense AS ae
WHERE ab.ad_amount > ae.avg_cost

),
